players.bio: Ajay Matthews is a 20-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward for EFL League Two club Exeter City, on a season-long loan from Championship side Millwall.
Andrew Jose Oluwabori (born Oluwadamilare Andrew Ijiwole on 30 September 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays for Yeovil Town, on loan from Exeter City, as a left winger and forward.
Anthony Richard Scully (born 19 April 1999) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Exeter City .
Charlie James Cummins (born 13 June 2005) is an Irish professional footballer who plays for Exeter City, as a midfielder and defender.

Daniel Watts is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Exeter City F.C.. He joined the League Two club on 01 September 2026 on a season-long loan deal from Championship side Swansea City A.F.C..

Daniel Antony Rose (born 10 December 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League Two club Exeter City. Born in Barnsley, Rose signed his first professional contract with hometown club Barnsley in March 2011, alongside Jordan Clark. He made his senior debut in the Football League on 25 April 2011,
Edward James Turns (born 18 October 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League Two club Exeter City. He is a Wales under-21 national international.
Ethan Sutherland is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a left wing-back or left-back for Exeter City, on loan from Wolverhampton Wanderers.
George Birch is a English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Exeter City F.C. in EFL League Two.

Gwion Dafydd Rhys Edwards (born 1 March 1993) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a winger for Morecambe. He is a former Wales Under-21 international. After spells with clubs including Aberystwyth Town and Cardiff City, Edwards joined Swansea City Football Club as an U15.

Harry George Kite is an English professional footballer who last played as a midfielder for Exeter City . Kite joined the Exeter City Academy at the under-9 stage, and went on to make his first-team debut on 29 August 2017.
Jack Thomas Bycroft (born 21 September 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Exeter City.
Jack Joseph Fitzwater (born 23 September 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Exeter City.

Jake Billy Doyle-Hayes (born 30 December 1998) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL League Two club Exeter City. He has represented Ireland as a youth international.

Jayden Wareham (born 13 May 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Wycombe Wanderers. Woking Wareham started his career at Reading and then Queens Park Rangers before he was released in 2019 and eventually joining National League side, Woking.

Joshua Luke Gordon (born 10 October 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for Exeter City. Gordon played youth football for his hometown club Stoke City but was released as a sixteen-year-old. He eventually joined the junior ranks at Newcastle Town before making his way through the age groups to the first team playing in the Evo-Stik Division One South.
Kieran Wilson (born 23 March 2007) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a forward for Hull City U21.
Lakyle Samuel is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Exeter City on loan from Manchester City.

Liam Oakes is a 19-year-old professional footballer who plays as a versatile midfielder and left wing-back for Exeter City F.C. in EFL League Two. An academy graduate who joined the club at the under-9 level, Oakes signed his first professional contract with the Grecians in March 2025.
Louie Cayless is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender (centre-back) and defensive midfielder for Exeter City F.C..
Luca Jack Alexander Woodhouse (born 25 July 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Exeter City.
Matthew James Taylor (born 30 January 1982) is an English professional football manager and former player who played as a centre back. He is currently the manager of EFL League Two club Exeter City.
Reece George Cole (born 17 February 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL League Two club Exeter City.
Sonny Cox (born 11 October 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Exeter City.
Taylor Perry is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Exeter City F.C..

Vincent McDyess Harper is a Kenyan professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for EFL League Two club Exeter City, on loan from EFL League Two side Walsall, and the Kenya national team.
